PainmailPassive
Instant
Dealing damage with Reap, Dreadwake and Soul Strike now grants a stack of Painmail for 15 sec, stacking up to 8 times. Additional applications do not refresh the effect.

When Painmail stacks expire naturally, you are healed for 2% of your maximum health and reduce the cooldown of Bolstered Form by 0.5 sec for each stack.
